description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying payments associated with a specific shop. It includes static route generation for a set of shop IDs, and renders a PaymentsClient component with the decoded shop ID. It also exports some static configuration for the route and documents the purpose of the page.

methods.name: ShopPaymentsPage
methods.description: An async React component that retrieves the shopId parameter, decodes it, and renders the PaymentsClient component for the specified shop.
